"""PCA of gene-level counts, treated vs untreated. See PLAN.md (sample-pca)."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA


def main(counts_path, design_path, out_dir):
    out = Path(out_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    design = pd.read_csv(design_path)
    counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, sep="\t").set_index("gene_id").drop(columns="gene_name")
    samples = list(design["sample_id"])
    if set(samples) != set(counts.columns):
        sys.exit("sample mismatch: design %s vs counts %s" % (sorted(samples), sorted(counts.columns)))
    counts = counts[samples]

    counts = counts[counts.sum(axis=1) >= 10]
    logc = np.log2(counts + 1)
    top = logc.var(axis=1).nlargest(500).index
    x = logc.loc[top].T.values
    x = x - x.mean(axis=0)

    n = min(6, len(samples))
    pca = PCA(n_components=n, svd_solver="full")
    scores = pca.fit_transform(x)
    pcs = ["PC%d" % (i + 1) for i in range(n)]

    sc = pd.DataFrame(scores, columns=pcs)
    sc.insert(0, "condition", design["condition"].values)
    sc.insert(0, "sample_id", samples)
    sc.to_csv(out / "pca_scores.tsv", sep="\t", index=False, float_format="%.6g")

    ev = pca.explained_variance_ratio_
    pd.DataFrame({"component": pcs, "variance_explained": ev, "cumulative": np.cumsum(ev)}).to_csv(
        out / "pca_variance.tsv", sep="\t", index=False, float_format="%.6g")

    fig, (a, b) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [2, 1]})
    colors = {"untreated": "#1f77b4", "treated": "#d62728"}
    for cond, g in sc.groupby("condition"):
        a.scatter(g["PC1"], g["PC2"], s=60, label=cond, color=colors.get(cond))
        for _, r in g.iterrows():
            a.annotate(r["sample_id"], (r["PC1"], r["PC2"]), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(5, 5))
    a.set_xlabel("PC1 (%.1f%%)" % (100 * ev[0]))
    a.set_ylabel("PC2 (%.1f%%)" % (100 * ev[1]))
    a.legend(title="condition")
    a.set_title("PCA, top %d variable genes" % len(top))
    b.bar(range(1, n + 1), 100 * ev)
    b.set_xlabel("component")
    b.set_ylabel("variance explained (%)")
    b.set_title("Scree")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(out / "pca_plot.png", dpi=150)


if __name__ == "__main__":
